answer: The kernel schedule is applied in knoll and saffron publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2353 identities would post 3818 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
